residuals: RES1 (accepted class, not a blocker): the raw response file passed via --momentum-response sits on the shared box and is writable by any box agent. A forger with a fresh eToro-style timestamp/xRequestId could pass. Same class as the forgeable verdict/score files Ofer has not accepted; mitigated by the 60 s server/capture timestamps and audited xRequestId+sha.
RES2 (minor): xRequestId is only checked for presence, not uniqueness. Replay is bounded by the 60 s window.
RES3 (minor): the optional parent_response has no freshness check (a 3-minute-old parent read still cross-checked OK). Suggest applying the same 60 s bound when it is supplied.
RES4 (minor): order statuses canceledPartiallyFilled/rejectedPartiallyFilled count as held. Conservative, acceptable.
recommended: Optionally reject a reused xRequestId across GOs (RES2)
